title: The Mpikabary: Madagascar's Oral Storytelling Tradition
description: The mpikabary — masters of oratory and narrative — are among the custodians of Malagasy oral culture, which has for centuries held knowledge, history, and cosmology in spoken form. The tradition of kabary encompasses storytelling, public oration, and the transmission of ancestral wisdom between generations. This living tradition was captured on film by César and Marie-Clémence Paes in Angano...Angano... (1989), whose title echoes the traditional opening of a Malagasy tale — angano, angano — signalling entry into narrative time.
